neighbours.label: limiting or frequency adverb before a verb that says how it is done ('can only make', 'is most often diagnosed')
fire: These are trips you can only take in the dry season.
The disease is most often found in older dogs.
This is a mistake you can only make once.
The fault is most often traced to a loose cable.
It is a dish you can only get in the north.
Asthma is most often treated with an inhaler.
That is a view you can only see from the top.
The rash is most often seen on the arms.
quiet: These are trips you can take in the dry season.
The disease is a problem for older dogs.
This is a mistake you can fix in a day.
The fault is a loose cable in the back.
It is a dish you can get in the north.
Asthma is a common condition in children.
That is a view you can see from the top.
The rash is a mild one on the arms.

notes: Output direction promotes ' still', ' carefully', ' tightly', ' accordingly'. Card: ' only' x5, ' most' x2, ' are' x2, ' it' x2. Probe: 'can only make' 0.39, 'most often diagnosed' 0.35, 'are treated', 'are trimmed' 0.17; plain versions 0.08.
